-- task3.sql: Task 1, CREATE TABLE statements
-- ============================================================================
-- AISE 3309 Assignment 3, Group 6: Engineering Part Sourcer
-- Generated by SRC/build_ddl.py from RELS in Assignment2/build_report.py.
-- Do not edit by hand: change build_ddl.py (types, CHECKs, indexes) or RELS
-- (keys, FKs) and rerun it.
--
-- Target: MySQL 8.0.16 or later (CHECK constraints are only enforced from
-- 8.0.16; earlier versions parse and silently ignore them). Tested on MySQL
-- 26.10.0 with sql_mode ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY, STRICT_TRANS_TABLES.
--
-- Conventions
--   * ISO SQL throughout. Identifiers are unquoted (no backticks, no double
--     quotes). Every MySQL-only statement is marked "MySQL-specific".
--   * Keys are named constraints: pk_<Relation>, ak_<Relation>_<n>,
--     fk_<Relation>_<Target>, ck_<Relation>_<rule>.
--   * Every FK column is NOT NULL and uses ON UPDATE CASCADE. ON DELETE is
--     taken from the Assignment 2 referential integrity table.
--   * Derived attributes (/AvgStarRating, /NumberOfParts, /UnpricedParts,
--     /TotalCost, /Subtotal, /ShippingPrice, /TotalPrice) are NOT columns.
--     They are computed in queries and in the BOMTotals view (task8.sql).
--   * No triggers (group decision; the handout makes them optional). See the
--     "Constraints not enforced by the DBMS" block at the end of this file.
-- ============================================================================

-- MySQL-specific: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS. ISO SQL has DROP TABLE <name>
-- [RESTRICT | CASCADE] with no IF EXISTS; it lets this script be rerun.
-- Children are dropped before their parents.
sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS Review;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS CartLine;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS BOMSelection;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS BOMLine;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS PartAlternative;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS SharedProject;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS BOM;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ShoppingCart;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS Listing;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS Distributor;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS Part;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS Customer;

CREATE TABLE Customer (
    Email        VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL,
    Username     VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    Password     VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,  -- a salted hash, never plain text
    FirstName    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    LastName     VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    HouseAddress VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    UnitNum      VARCHAR(10),
    City         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    Province     VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    Country      VARCHAR(56) NOT NULL,
    PostCode     VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_Customer PRIMARY KEY (Email),
    CONSTRAINT ak_Customer_1 UNIQUE (Username)
);

CREATE TABLE Part (
    ManufacturerName     VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Manufacturer_PartNum VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Name                 VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    Description          VARCHAR(1000),
    Category             VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    Length               DECIMAL(8,2),  -- millimetres
    Width                DECIMAL(8,2),
    Height               DECIMAL(8,2),
    Datasheet_link       VARCHAR(2048),
    CONSTRAINT pk_Part PRIMARY KEY (ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum),
    CONSTRAINT ck_Part_dims CHECK (Length > 0 AND Width > 0 AND Height > 0)  -- a NULL dimension makes the CHECK unknown, which passes (ISO rule)
);

CREATE TABLE Distributor (
    Name        VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Website     VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    ShippingFee DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_Distributor PRIMARY KEY (Name),
    CONSTRAINT ak_Distributor_1 UNIQUE (Website),
    CONSTRAINT ck_Distributor_fee CHECK (ShippingFee >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE Listing (
    DistributorName      VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Distributor_PartNum  VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    ManufacturerName     VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Manufacturer_PartNum VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Packaging            VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    UnitPrice            DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
    StockQuantity        INTEGER NOT NULL,
    EstShipTime          INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- estimated shipping time in days
    LastUpdated          TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_Listing PRIMARY KEY (DistributorName, Distributor_PartNum),
    CONSTRAINT ak_Listing_1 UNIQUE (DistributorName, ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum, Packaging),
    CONSTRAINT fk_Listing_Distributor FOREIGN KEY (DistributorName)
        REFERENCES Distributor (Name)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_Listing_Part FOREIGN KEY (ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum)
        REFERENCES Part (ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum)
        ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT ck_Listing_price CHECK (UnitPrice >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT ck_Listing_stock CHECK (StockQuantity >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT ck_Listing_ship CHECK (EstShipTime >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT ck_Listing_pack CHECK (Packaging IN ('Cut Tape', 'Tape & Reel', 'Tray', 'Bulk', 'Tube'))  -- replaces a MySQL ENUM with an ISO CHECK on a fixed list
);

CREATE TABLE ShoppingCart (
    CustomerEmail VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL,
    Date_created  DATE NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_ShoppingCart PRIMARY KEY (CustomerEmail),
    CONSTRAINT fk_ShoppingCart_Customer FOREIGN KEY (CustomerEmail)
        REFERENCES Customer (Email)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE BOM (
    CustomerEmail VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL,
    BOM_name      VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    Date_created  DATE NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_BOM PRIMARY KEY (CustomerEmail, BOM_name),
    CONSTRAINT fk_BOM_Customer FOREIGN KEY (CustomerEmail)
        REFERENCES Customer (Email)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE SharedProject (
    CustomerEmail VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL,
    BOM_name      VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    Title         VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    Description   VARCHAR(1000),
    Date_shared   DATE NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_SharedProject PRIMARY KEY (CustomerEmail, BOM_name),
    CONSTRAINT ak_SharedProject_1 UNIQUE (CustomerEmail, Title),
    CONSTRAINT fk_SharedProject_BOM FOREIGN KEY (CustomerEmail, BOM_name)
        REFERENCES BOM (CustomerEmail, BOM_name)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE PartAlternative (
    Part1_ManufacturerName VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Part1_PartNum          VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Part2_ManufacturerName VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Part2_PartNum          VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_PartAlternative PRIMARY KEY (Part1_ManufacturerName, Part1_PartNum, Part2_ManufacturerName, Part2_PartNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_PartAlternative_Part1 FOREIGN KEY (Part1_ManufacturerName, Part1_PartNum)
        REFERENCES Part (ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_PartAlternative_Part2 FOREIGN KEY (Part2_ManufacturerName, Part2_PartNum)
        REFERENCES Part (ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE BOMLine (
    CustomerEmail        VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL,
    BOM_name             VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    ManufacturerName     VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Manufacturer_PartNum VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Quantity             INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_BOMLine PRIMARY KEY (CustomerEmail, BOM_name, ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_BOMLine_BOM FOREIGN KEY (CustomerEmail, BOM_name)
        REFERENCES BOM (CustomerEmail, BOM_name)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_BOMLine_Part FOREIGN KEY (ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum)
        REFERENCES Part (ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum)
        ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT ck_BOMLine_qty CHECK (Quantity > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE BOMSelection (
    CustomerEmail       VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL,
    BOM_name            VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    DistributorName     VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Distributor_PartNum VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_BOMSelection PRIMARY KEY (CustomerEmail, BOM_name, DistributorName, Distributor_PartNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_BOMSelection_BOM FOREIGN KEY (CustomerEmail, BOM_name)
        REFERENCES BOM (CustomerEmail, BOM_name)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_BOMSelection_Listing FOREIGN KEY (DistributorName, Distributor_PartNum)
        REFERENCES Listing (DistributorName, Distributor_PartNum)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE CartLine (
    CustomerEmail       VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL,
    DistributorName     VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Distributor_PartNum VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Quantity            INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_CartLine PRIMARY KEY (CustomerEmail, DistributorName, Distributor_PartNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_CartLine_ShoppingCart FOREIGN KEY (CustomerEmail)
        REFERENCES ShoppingCart (CustomerEmail)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_CartLine_Listing FOREIGN KEY (DistributorName, Distributor_PartNum)
        REFERENCES Listing (DistributorName, Distributor_PartNum)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT ck_CartLine_qty CHECK (Quantity > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE Review (
    CustomerEmail        VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL,
    ManufacturerName     VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Manufacturer_PartNum VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    ReviewText           VARCHAR(2000),
    StarRating           INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_Review PRIMARY KEY (CustomerEmail, ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_Review_Customer FOREIGN KEY (CustomerEmail)
        REFERENCES Customer (Email)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_Review_Part FOREIGN KEY (ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum)
        REFERENCES Part (ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum)
        ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT ck_Review_stars CHECK (StarRating BETWEEN 1 AND 5)  -- C1
);

-- Indexes
-- MySQL-specific: CREATE INDEX is not part of ISO SQL (indexes are a
-- physical design choice the standard leaves to the DBMS), but it is the
-- form taught in lectures (C&B 7.3.5). InnoDB already indexes every PK,
-- UNIQUE and FK, so only the two indexes below are added.
-- Filter by category (Assignment 1 Filter function, Task 4 Q2/Q6). No key starts with Category.
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_Part_Category ON Part (Category);

comments: -- Price Match: all offers for one part ordered by price. Also serves the FK to Part, so InnoDB reuses it instead of building a separate FK index.
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_Listing_Part_Price ON Listing (ManufacturerName, Manufacturer_PartNum, UnitPrice);
